name: Promising Semantics
description: An operational model for relaxed memory based on the notion of thread-local 'promises': a thread may promise a future write and later fulfil it. Eliminates thin-air values, supports DRF-SC, and can express optimisation-friendly behaviour. Extended to PS 2.0 for mixed-size and non-atomic accesses.

catSupport.note: A promise is legal only if the promising thread can certify it by a future thread-local execution, so whether one execution is allowed depends on other executions — not statable as a per-execution cat predicate. IMM was introduced precisely to give Promising a declarative over-approximation.
